results.evidence: The itinerary frames a two-day plan with an optional camp ('camp if needed'), while timing gives a single 9-hour day with an alpine start. Available route pages (approach from Rainy Pass ~1.5 mi on the PCT then ~2 mi and 2,300 ft to the peak) give distance and gain but no stated car-to-car duration or day count; SummitPost and Mountaineers pages returned 403 and no trip report stating the day count for THIS route was found. Would be settled by two trip reports giving car-to-car time / number of days for the North Ridge - West Side.

results.fact: Cutthroat Lake camp text describes a different peak's approach
results.evidence: Bivy-only dispute; bivy[] is owned by the camping clean-up. Entry 0 (Cutthroat Creek trailhead) serves this route's approach (1); entry 1 (Cutthroat Lake basin) lies on approach (1) but its note is written for Cutthroat Peak's south-side/North Ridge routes (State Creek pullout), not Molar Tooth, and does not serve approach (2) from Rainy Pass.

results.correct_value: Summer overnight lows around 40-50°F; freezing nights are rare in July-August
results.evidence: NRCS SNOTEL daily minimum temperatures for July-August 2021-2025: Rainy Pass (4,880 ft, the route's trailhead) averaged 48.3°F with no night at or below 32°F in 310 days; Harts Pass (6,490 ft, nearby at route elevation) averaged 45.8°F with only 3 of 310 nights at or below 32°F. Both confirm the 40-50°F figure the row already states and contradict 'freezing common'.

patches.find: Clear skies with 40-50°F overnight freezing for early-morning frozen gully conditions.
